dependencies.description: Frontend calls API gateway for all backend operations
Gateway proxies auth requests to auth-service
Gateway proxies user requests to user-service
Gateway proxies document requests to knowledge-service
Gateway proxies metadata requests to metadata-service
Gateway proxies analytics/feedback requests to feedback-service
user-service publishes User.status.changed and User.revoked events via RabbitMQ
knowledge-service publishes Document.uploaded and Document.deleted events via RabbitMQ
user-service owns core.user_profiles and core.departments tables
knowledge-service owns knowledge.documents, document_versions, processing_jobs, chunks tables
feedback-service owns analytics.* and conversation.* tables
Auth store uses AuthService for logout/logoutAll
Auth store uses API lib for token management
Sidebar uses auth store for role-based menu
Header uses auth store for user info
API lib imports all type definitions
ProxyService uses JwtAuthService for token injection
